name: Natsuki Kazuto
source:
The perfect brother of Akito, and the husband of Miyuri. A diligent office worker. Is more dense than Akito when it comes to women. He wants a child soon, and is talking about it with Miyuri. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.alicesoft.com/tsumamigui3/chara/sub.html]Official Site[/url]]
